exposure: antibiotics to children before 2 years of age
cohort: The study included all 536,819 children born in Norway between 2004 and 2012.
finding: Children exposed to antibiotics before 2 years of age were more likely to develop pediatric IBD (aOR 1.33), with a dose-response association and greater effect estimates for broad-spectrum antibiotics, while prenatal antibiotic exposure was numerically but not statistically significantly associated.
